info.title: Backups & Support
info.details: Reliable backups (automatic, daily, off-site) and accessible, knowledgeable support (24/7 preferred) are crucial for peace of mind.

benefits: Backups: Look for automatic, daily backups stored off-site (not on the same server). Check the retention period (how long backups are kept) and how easily you can restore a backup yourself.
Support Channels: Common options include live chat, phone support, and email/ticket systems. Consider which channels you prefer and their availability (24/7 support is ideal).
Support Quality: Is the support team knowledgeable about WordPress? Check reviews or ask pre-sales questions to gauge their expertise and response times.
Self-Help: A good knowledge base or documentation section on the host's website can be very helpful for common issues.
